topic: How to Open a Brokerage Account
source_evidence: Make sure you understand what these terms mean and how much risk is involved with each objective.
answer: When opening a brokerage account, you may be asked to choose investment objectives and describe how much risk you are comfortable taking. Firms may use terms such as “capital preservation,” “income,” “growth,” or “aggressive growth,” and their labels can differ. Before choosing a category, make sure you understand what it means and the level of risk involved. Also consider when you might need quick access to the money in the account. If a term or choice is unclear, ask your broker.
